persona_issue_classifications.basis: Amy: "The same course, with the same flag and the same word, is shown in two places, and only one of them tells me it is my current course. From the list row I cannot predict whether I go back to my existing progress or begin again. Nothing on the screen settles it." — solution: "In the 'What would you like to learn?' list, mark Spanish the same way the menu does, for example with the blue ring and the words 'Current course', and say on the row what pressing it does, such as 'Continue Spanish'." — their reasoning is one job they could not recognise across two renderings, and their fix asks for the renderings to match
persona_issue_classifications.note: classification only; my own verdict is unchanged and the disagreement stands (persona opinion after testing: softened)

persona_issue_classifications.basis: Amy: "These involve money after the trial, so I need to know exactly what I am starting. One button says TRY 1 WEEK FOR FREE inside a family-plan box; the other says FREE TRIAL next to Unlimited. From the words I cannot tell whether they are one offer or two." — solution: "Name the plan and the length on the button itself, the same way in both places: for example 'Start 1-week free trial of Super Family' and 'Start 1-week free trial of Super (individual)'. If they are the same trial, use the same wording in both places." — their reasoning is one job they could not recognise across two renderings, and their fix asks for the renderings to match
